projection.formula_view0: sx = cx + 5*(x - y);  sy = cy + 2.5*(x + y) - 5*z   (1920x1080 reference, zoom 1)

camera.pan: WASD / edge scroll / middle-drag, clamped to ops-area bounds

ops_grid.far: infinite — never ends at screen edge; linear fade from alpha_near at near_radius_voxels to alpha_far at far_radius_voxels around the camera pivot, never to zero (D-059)

shield.shape_note: Scene envelope sized to cover all station voxels; four external JunctionTower projectors. Gameplay shield rules are unchanged.
shield.fill_note: Fill opacity of the whole shield as seen, back and front faces together (doc 01 §6: about 0.05; each of the two layers gets 1 - sqrt(1 - a)): rest_alpha_fill where the surface faces the viewer, rising to edge_alpha_fill at the silhouette as fresnel^fresnel_power (the mockup's radial gradient: 0.07 at 90% of the radius, 0.2 at the edge).
shield.line_note: Rim: the silhouette, in rim_color (rim_weak over a weak sector, in weak_color). Ring: the sector ring at the equator, one arc per sector (doc 01 §6: 2 px); ring_weak for a sector below weak_threshold; ring_far for the far half, seen through the globe. Widths, dashes (dash, gap; gap 0 is solid) and alphas are the mockup's, in 1080p pixels, scaling with the window like the other overlays.
shield.sectors_note: Arcs by azimuth around the centre, each centred on its pylon (Design D-046). Strengths are live data and come from the fixture (selection.pylons), not from here.
shield.hit: hex pattern ripple at impact point, 600 ms, radius 4-6 voxels

hits.hits_note: Doc 06 M4: hit ripples on a scripted loop at the two impact points of the reference. Each impact is where the reference render shows it, in reference pixels of view 0 at zoom 1; the client puts it where that pixel's view ray meets the globe's front surface. A ripple is a hex pattern (cells hex_cell_voxels across) growing to radius_voxels over ripple_ms with an outline in outline_color (outline_weak_color in a weak sector), plus a hot flash (doc 01 §6) over flash_ms. Colours and sizes are the mockup's; flash colours are doc 01 §6's.

elevation.cues: footprint outline on ops grid (dashed, #38d6ff 70%) + dashed corner stalks + ELEV tag on hover/selection only
elevation.style_note: Doc 01 §7 gives the footprint colour and alphas; widths, dash patterns and the stalk alpha are the mockup's (reference/mockup/ops-grid-proposal.html). Widths and dashes are 1080p pixels and scale with the window, not the zoom.

bloom.note: Glow on emissive palette entries (doc 01 §2): radius in 1080p pixels at zoom 1, scaling with zoom and window size; the Gaussian sigma is half the radius. The blurred emissive image times intensity is added to the frame: 'additive' adds it as is, 'screen' adds it scaled by the headroom left (glow * (1 - frame)), so pale emitters keep their tint instead of clipping to white.

hover.note: Hovered module: non-emissive faces are multiplied by 1 + brightness_lift (doc 06 M3).

lights_policy: At most about 100 emissive voxels on the station (data has 98): pylon emitters, docking collars, power-bus markers, sparse running lights. No light rows along edges.
